sections.title: Economic Contract Theory
sections.description: This is a course on economic contract theory, covering adverse selection contracts, moral hazard contracts, dynamic contracts, incomplete contracts, and renegotiation. Illustrative applications include price discrimination, auctions, insurance, ownership, and hold-up problems.
